Name: Plant Fruit Trees Anywhere (with dirt)
Author: CopperSun
Description:
Plant fruit trees anywhere you can plant pine/oak/maple/mahogany trees! Based on the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9800]Plant Fruit Trees in Forest[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/5575844]Lumisteria[/url]; if you like this mod, download that one as well and give it an endorsement.

This mod requires SDV 1.5.5.

Fruit trees [i]must be planted in tillable soil[/i], aka dirt. For more areas to plant, you can download map mods or make your own in [url=https://stardewmodding.miraheze.org/wiki/Category:Tiled]Tiled[/url] to, for example, add dirt patches to the bus tunnel.

I highly recommend pairing this mod with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9002]Host Trees[/url]. Planted in the forest you get a lovely feel of extra foraging as you harvest mistletoe, moss, lichen, etc to turn into crafts.

Maps this mod affects (all vanilla): Backwoods, Beach, BugLand, BusStop, Caldera, Desert, FarmCave, Forest (if Plant Fruit Trees in Forest is not installed), Island_E, Island_FarmCave, Island_N, Island_S, Island_Resort, Island_SE, Island_Shrine, Island_Shrine, Island_Shrine, Island_W, IslandNorthCave1, IslandSouthEastCave, IslandWestCave1, Mine, Mountain, Railroad, Sewer, SkullCave, Summit, Town, Tunnel, WitchSwamp, Woods

Note: If you are planning to plant on Ginger Island, make sure you've done any upgrades in that area (specifically the resort) [b]before[/b] you plant!!

This mod is [b]compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded[/b] and Wayback Pelican Town. This mod does [i]not [/i]affect your ability to plant fruit trees on Ridgeside Village and East Scarp maps.

Many thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/71424903]Asterisk555 [/url]for the screenshots.

Want to make your own mod? Many [url=https://stardewmodding.miraheze.org/wiki/Category:Tutorials]tutorials [/url]are available for all kinds of SDV mods! Take a look and give making your own mod a try. Warning, it can be addictive!
